notes: Adds missing core logic and integration depth for consent workflow.

change_log.value: Consent Tier Evaluation and State Machine Logic

stories.title: Consent Tier Evaluation and State Machine Logic
stories.description: Implement core consent workflow logic as a deterministic state machine supporting Tier 1 (basic interaction) and Tier 2 (PHI storage). Define valid transitions, escalation triggers, and rejection paths. Ensure all decisions are centrally enforced via consent_service.

stories.title: De-identification and Storage Decision Engine
stories.description: Implement logic to determine whether user data is stored, de-identified, or discarded based on consent tier. Integrate HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification rules and ensure all persisted data passes through this enforcement layer before reaching debug_logger or storage systems.

stories.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent enforcement across dependent services including lead_service, unknown_question_service, and debug_logger to ensure no PHI is stored or propagated without appropriate consent tier. Validate that all entry points respect consent decisions.
